syllabus_title: WAEC SSCE Woodwork to I.E. Detailed Syllabus

practical_section.description: The practical activities would require the use of common hand tools, portable power tools and basic woodworking machines, different joints and shapes, nails, screws and other fasteners and fittings, solid wood, manufactured boards and non-wood materials.
operations: Shaping – e.g. chamfering, rounding and tapering
Assembling and finishing – e.g. testing for squareness, parallelism, use of diagonals, trial assembly, cramping methods, preparation of surfaces and application of finishes

content: Machine safety (General machine shop safety, Safety precautions in the use of portable power tools and machines, Safety in machines operations, Prevention of mechanical faults)
Classification: geometrical, holding and supporting, impelling and percussion, cutting, boring, abrading and scraping tools
theory_sections.notes: To include identification, description and sketching.

content: Planes: spokeshaves, rebate Plane, Plough plane, block plane, shoulder plane etc.
Saws: bow saw, pad/keyhole saw, coping saw, fret saw
Boring bits: expansion bit, forstner bit, countersink bit, auger bit etc.
theory_sections.notes: To include identification, description and sketching.

content: Types: Power drill, jig saw, spray gun, screw driver, sanders, router, power circular saw etc.
theory_sections.notes: To include identification, description, care and safe use.

content: Types: Circular saw, crosscut saw, thicknesser, surface planer, mortiser, lathe, grinding wheel, drilling machine etc.
Types: corrective, routine, predictive and preventive
Maintenance of hand tools (oiling, sharpening, repairing, storing etc.)
Maintenance of machines (cleaning, oiling, servicing, replacing parts etc.)

theory_sections.topic: West African Timbers in common use
content: Common West African Timbers e.g. Iroko (Odum), abura, mahogany, obeche (Wawa), African walnut, afara, ebony, danta, emery, shedua, mansonia, cedar, afromosia (kokrodua), avodire, kusia
Conversion methods: plain/through and through/live sawing, Tangential/back/flat/rake sawing, Quarter/radial/rift sawing
Common market sizes: log, plank, scantling, board, batten, strip/lath, squares
Methods of seasoning: Natural/open air, artificial/kiln, water and chemical seasoning
Determination of moisture content: moisture meter method, oven dry method
Types of defects: natural growth defects, felling defects, conversion defects, seasoning defects, defects caused by Organisms
theory_sections.notes: Causes, prevention, remedies, description and sketching.

content: Properties of a good timber preservative
Methods of applying timber preservatives: brushing, dipping, spraying etc.

theory_sections.notes: Advantages and disadvantages of each type.

content: Operational sequence: hand preparation, machine preparation

Classification: widening joints (simple butt, dowel, tongued and grooved, loose tongue, rebated butt etc.), angle joints (mortise and tenon, dowelled butt, dovetails, housing, halving etc.), framing joints (mortise and tenon, bridle, plain mitre, dowelled butt, halving etc.)
theory_sections.notes: To include identification, description, sketching, construction, specific use etc.

content: Types: fillers, stains, paints, varnishes, lacquers, polishes etc.
Application of finishes: surface preparation, tools, methods (brushing, spraying, dipping, etc.)
theory_sections.notes: Properties, characteristics and uses; stages and tools; Safety precautions.

content: Types: protein (animal, casein), synthetic resins (urea, phenol and melamine formaldehydes, epoxyl resins, polyvinyl acetate (PVA)), contact/rubber based
theory_sections.notes: Characteristics, uses, preparation and application and safety precaution.

content: Fittings: e.g. hinges, locks, handles, bolts, catches etc.
Fasteners: Nails, screws, bolts and nuts, corrugated fasteners etc.
theory_sections.notes: Identification, description, sketching, uses, application, fixing etc.

content: Glass, plastics, rubber, ceramics, metal, leather etc.
Veneering: Methods (hammer, press), Tools (veneer hammer, pressing iron, cramps, caul etc.)
Shaping: Rounding, moulding, bevelling, chamfering, tapering, carving etc.
Cutting list and bill of materials
